task_name: Semantic Definition of Each Array Item
description: Iterates sequentially through an input array to semantically define each item. Enforces strict private-scope variable isolation (no public or global variables), filters and counts non-empty items to size the return schema precisely, applies a deterministic verification gate to each generated definition, archives intermediate results in batches, and performs comprehensive final verification.

no_public_variables_constraint.rule: All variables, state accumulators, pointers, and iterators must reside exclusively within the local function or block execution scope. No state or variable may be bound to global, module-level, or public scope namespaces.

nonempty_item_count.definition: Count of elements in input_array that are non-null, non-undefined, and contain at least one non-whitespace character after trimming.
nonempty_item_count.formula: input_array.filter(item => typeof item === 'string' ? item.trim().length > 0 : (item !== null && item !== undefined)).length
nonempty_item_count.exclusion_policy: Empty strings, null, undefined, or whitespace-only elements are skipped during semantic definition generation and excluded from the count.

return_schema_sizing.rule: The length of the returned definitions array must exactly match nonempty_item_count. Under-allocation, truncation, or excess padding is prohibited.

batch_archive_requirement.rule: When the accumulator reaches the specified batch_size or when the final element is processed, the current batch of verified definitions must be committed and appended to the persistent batch_archives array before continuing.

criteria.description: Source item must be verified as non-null and non-empty.
Definition object must include non-empty source_item, item_index, semantic_definition, category, and confidence_score.
semantic_definition must be substantive (minimum 10 characters) and provide contextual meaning rather than tautological repetition.
Verify no variables were leaked into global or outer public scopes during definition synthesis.

ordered_instructions.description: Initialize the execution context in strict private local scope. Verify that no global or public variables are created or referenced.
Scan the input array to determine the total item count and calculate the exact nonempty_item_count by filtering out null, undefined, and whitespace-only entries.
Construct and allocate the return schema containers, setting the capacity of the definitions collection to match nonempty_item_count exactly.
Initialize the sequential iterator at index 0 and allocate a local private batch accumulator array with a maximum capacity of batch_size.
Read the element at current iterator index. If the element is empty or null, log omission in skipped_indices and proceed to step 9.
Generate a rigorous semantic definition for the current non-empty item, capturing semantic meaning, domain context, taxonomy category, and confidence score.
Pass the newly generated definition through the verification gate. Ensure all gate criteria pass before appending the definition to the active batch accumulator.

If the batch accumulator size equals batch_size or if the current item is the last non-empty item, commit the batch to batch_archives, append definitions to the main return array, and reset the batch accumulator.
Increment the iterator index by exactly 1. If iterator index is less than input array length, return to step 5.
Execute comprehensive final verification checks against all outputs, validating count equality, gate passes, archive integrity, and private-variable isolation.

mandatory_checks.description: Confirm that global and public scope remained pristine with zero variable leakage during execution.
Confirm that definitions appear in strictly ascending order corresponding to their original input array indices.
Verify that all definitions are accounted for in batch_archives and total archived items equal nonempty_item_count.
Verify that every processed item has an associated verification_gate PASS record.

definitions.description: Strictly sized collection containing definitions for each non-empty input array item.

batch_archives.description: Archived batches committed at designated batch intervals or iteration end.
